leadText:
The boss fantasy (Japanese: ニャース妄想 delusion) is a segment in in which thinks of practical uses can make of the being focused on in the current episode. Through this, the Giovanni in Meowth's imagination rewards for their generosity, which gives Jessie and James the motivation to go through with their next plan, only for and to go after and foil it once it is carried out. The segment often depicts Giovanni in humorous and exaggerated situations.

The segment debuted in the episode Bye Bye Butterfree!, but became regular only after The Kecleon Caper in , appearing as often as the and blast offs during the . The segment appeared less often in . Due to the shifting to a more serious tone, the boss fantasies did not appear in , though afterwards they made a return in , the , and the , although much less frequently than before.
 
It can be noted that the Giovanni in such fantasies almost always says he will reward "Meowth and his friends" for bringing (Pokémon so and so) instead of "Jessie, James, and Meowth" or a variation of that. This can be attributed to the fact that Meowth is usually the one who dreams up these fantasies, and his ego causes him to imagine Giovanni rewarding him first, then his friends. In one episode, James finishes off the fantasy, where he imagines Giovanni saying "James and his friends" instead. Occasionally, Meowth will imagine Giovanni in form while in others, Meowth will imagine Giovanni with a muscle-covered body. Sometimes Jessie and/or James will point out the flaws in the fantasy, but more often than not will allow themsleves to be swept up in the excitement of gaining Giovanni's praise.

On rare occasions, the fantasy will not pan out as planned and Giovanni's unhappiness encourages the trio to do something else instead.

The reality, however, is that since Giovanni's behavior in these fantasies are solely based around Meowth's opinion on how he would react, they don't reflect Giovanni's true personality since the trio remain unaware of his personal dislike (and sometimes, his general disinterest) towards them at the time. On most occasions, Meowth is so overconfident with these fantasies that he doesn't realize that his plans are generally flawed and wouldn't actually work, usually due to Giovanni's desire for only strong Pokémon.
